title: Substrate Launch: the API for modular AI
talk_summary: Substrate is a developer SDK plus inference engine for describing multi-node computation graphs (text, JSON, images, embeddings, code) and running them on a coordinated cluster so batching, caching, concurrency, and placement can be optimized. The pitch is that modular systems of inference runs are more legible, debuggable, and evaluable than monolithic model calls, with in-cluster node-to-node data transfer claimed ~10,000x faster than chained external API calls.

takeaways.technique: Explicit computation graph over inference nodes
takeaways.what_they_do: Describe multi-step AI work as a graph of typed nodes (text, JSON, embeddings, code) so the decision tree is explicit and each step can be inspected and evaluated.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the best products right now are all using systems of inference runs in a logical structure

takeaways.what_they_do: Because the graph is explicit, they can verify at every step what is going on and what is going wrong, making evals easier than with monolithic agents.
takeaways.evidence_quote: evals become a lot easier because the decision trees are explicit and you can sort of verify at every step

takeaways.technique: In-process node handoff instead of chained API calls
takeaways.what_they_do: Run nodes inside one coordinated cluster so data moves process-to-process, avoiding DNS, proxy, auth, and balance-check overhead on every step.
takeaways.evidence_quote: every step means you've got to resolve DNS you've got to go through through proxies you've got it through authentication
takeaways.numbers: claims microseconds vs hundreds of milliseconds per step, ~10,000x faster

takeaways.technique: Best-in-class JSON mode for multi-step runs
takeaways.what_they_do: Invest in reliable, fast structured JSON output as the primary interface between inference nodes.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Json decoding is is one of the most useful patterns for multi-inference runs
